title: Reading-room site pack
description: Everything a site may change about the shared reading room. Anything not in a pack is the same for every site. roomkit validates packs with this schema plus the checks a schema cannot state (roomkit/pack.py: contrast, CSS scoping, the parity matrix, font files). Civica validates tenant packs against this same file.

site.description: The pack's site; a manifest's site.template names it.

base_url.description: https://host with no path or trailing slash; empty for a site-agnostic pack.

backdrop.description: What shows through a transparent page-bg (the site's page color). The contrast check measures against it, and the page paints its body with it.

tokens_dark.description: Dark scheme overrides; when present, every color token.

token_notes.description: Why a token's value is what it is, when it is not simply the site's (pack_import.py writes these from the map).

fonts.description: Self-hosted font files in the pack. No CDN.

chrome.description: The room's own header, navigation and footer (plan Task 5). Text and links only: the look comes from the tokens.

home.description: The site's name in the header, linking to its home page.

tagline.description: A line under the site's name.

skip_text.description: The skip link, the page's first focusable element; it targets #room-content.

nav_label.description: The accessible name of the site navigation (nav aria-label).

menu_label.description: The summary that opens the navigation on narrow screens (details/summary, no JavaScript).

inline_from.description: The viewport width (em) from which the nav's links sit in one row beside the site's name; below it, the Menu button. Measured per site in a browser: the narrowest width where name, gap and the whole link row fit, with margin for font differences.

nav.description: Links, or labelled groups of links (a submenu).

notice.description: A site-wide line under the header.

footer.description: Columns of footer links, each with an optional heading.

footer_text.description: Footer paragraphs (license, disclaimers), verbatim from the site.

source.description: Where the chrome was taken from. Not rendered.

group.description: The group as a label (finder select, jump list), as the site writes it, e.g. "Category".

group_singular.description: Count noun for one group ("1 category").

groups_plural.description: Count noun for any other number of groups ("4 categories").

record_singular.description: Count noun for one record ("1 record").

record_plural.description: Count noun for any other number of records ("5 records").

jump.description: The jump list's visible label ("Jump to jurisdiction:"). The nav's accessible name is this text minus trailing punctuation.

stats_singular.description: Optional: the noun beside the record count in the index header, when the site's header names them differently from its result count (GG: "455 documents" in the header, "455 records" in the count). Defaults to record_singular; set it with stats_plural.

stats_plural.description: Optional: stats_singular's plural. Defaults to record_plural.

fulltext_placeholder.description: The search box placeholder when features.corpus-search is on (it searches record text, not only titles).

labels.description: Words the room shows. The count nouns are required: the room never builds a plural (no +"s"), it picks singular or plural by the count.

toggle.description: localStorage key of a light/dark toggle shared with the site, or empty for none.

features.description: Surfaces the pack turns on. The template renders a surface only when the pack enables it and the manifest supports it.

collections.description: GG's collections page, collection pages and the index's collections table at their live paths, from the manifest's `collections` block (site_collections.py). Every word and list comes from the export. Off: no collection page, no table, no collections.css or room-collections.js.

machine-text.description: The site's plain-text record index (GG /library/documents.txt) as the exporter wrote it, from the manifest's `machine_text` block (machine_text.py), with a UTF-8 charset in .htaccess. Off: no file, and .htaccess unchanged.

topics.description: GG's topics page and every page of every topic (/page/N/ as live) at their live paths, from the manifest's `topics` block (topics.py). Every word, row and paging link comes from the export. Off: no topic page and no topics.css. The in-topic ?s= filter is not rendered (parity-matrix.yaml topics).

entities.description: The site's entity index and entity pages at their live paths, built from the manifest's `entities` block (entities.py). Every heading, label, count and list comes from the export; nothing is composed. Off: no entity page, no link into one, no entities.css.

passage-cite.description: GG's passage citations (passages.py): the reader's Cite page shows each page's exported citation from pages.json with no request; per-hit Cite asks the site's passage route (manifest passages.api) and falls back to the page citation when that fails; curated citations ship as citations.json.

corpus-search.description: A Pagefind index over every record's title, summary, citation, agency, group and page text, built into the room (pagefind/); the finder searches it and suggests from it. Needs the pinned Pagefind (search.py).

facet-pages.description: A page per value of each facet the manifest's site.index.browse names, at <room>/<facet>/<value>/, linked from a browse block on the index: the way to narrow the list without JavaScript (browse.py). Off: no facet page, no browse block, no browse.css.

sitemaps.description: sitemap.xml at the room's root: every page the room serves by its live canonical URL (browse.py).

csp.description: A Content-Security-Policy header in the room's .htaccess (build.py CSP): scripts, workers, frames and connections only from the room's own origin, no plugins beyond the PDF object. Off: no header, as before. Hosts that ignore .htaccess must send the same policy themselves.

extra_css.description: An escape hatch, scoped under #room-content (or the page's body.room-plain).

url.description: https://, or a path on the same host.

pack_file.description: A path inside the pack directory.

nav_item.description: A link (label, url) or a labelled group of links (label, links), never both.
